Mock server delays response longer than request_timeout, surfacing a timeout error

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
begin
  engine_config = { 'request_timeout' => 500 }
  engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
  url = 'https://example.com'
  result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
